children: Callan JMB, through subsidiary Callan Power, entered into an Asset Purchase and Sale Agreement to buy 50% of Pfanenstiel Company’s oil and gas leases and wells in North Dakota and Montana. The $12.5 million cash deal includes a $1.0 million escrow to cover the buyer’s share of drilling and completion costs through closing. Closing is expected by Sep 30, 2026, subject to due diligence, financing, and other customary conditions. The assets are acquired on an “as is, where is” basis, with certain wellbores excluded.
